Rina (product): Quick review: new Compliance table iteration landed in Figma. Need quick feedback on a few UI nits before we ship: 1) retention summary wording + line-wraps, 2) region picker empty state, 3) encryption/KMS badges (labeling + visual priority), 4) export audit copy and affordance.
Leo (design): Saw the mocks. Main UX smells: retention blurb currently wraps into 2 lines and increases row height; KMS pill looks same as status tags; region dropdown has no affordance when collapsed.
Ava (eng): Implementation constraints callout: exports are server-streamed and paginated. If we change the CTA to a modal with options (format, time range), need backend change to accept `cursor` + `format` params. Low-medium effort.
Noah (a11y): Keyboard + screen reader checklist: focus order should follow visual flow (left-to-right). If we compress retention into inline text we must ensure it's readable by SRs: prefer a `aria-describedby` on the row that SRs can open.
Rina (product): Good note. Leo, can you propose single-line copies? Also think about default emphasis: should BYOK be more noticeable than Redwood-managed?
Leo (design): Single-line options: a) "Retention: 30 days — see policy" b) "Data retained for 30 days. Learn more." c) "30-day retention (editable)". My pick is b for scan-ability. For badges: make Redwood-managed subtle (low-contrast text) and BYOK a filled outline pill with a small key icon.
Dana (legal): Avoid wording that suggests admin can change retention if the feature is not GA. So avoid "editable" until it's real. Option b is safe if "Learn more" links to the canonical retention policy.
Ava (eng): On badge icons: svg key + `role="img" aria-label="customer-managed key"` is fine. We can add `data-key-type="byok|managed"` if front-end needs to style.
Noah (a11y): For the key icon, ensure it has an accessible name (either aria-label or hidden text). Icon-only buttons need `aria-label="Customer-managed key, opens key details"` if clickable.
Rina (product): Export button currently says "Download". That is ambiguous about filters. Proposals: "Export logs (filtered)" "Export current view" "Export CSV". Which is clearest?
Leo (design): UX-wise show a small chevron next to Export to indicate options (CSV/JSON). Primary label: "Export (CSV)" with secondary menu for JSON. Also put a tooltip: "Exports respect active filters and time range".
Dana (legal): Use the word "Export" consistently. Also we should avoid implying immutability  maybe add tiny helper text: "Export reflects current filters."
Ava (eng): Backend accepts `format=csv` default. If UI puts CSV in label we can set that param client-side and avoid extra config.
Noah (a11y): For the export menu, ensure the menu is accessible: `role=menu` and keyboard nav, provide visually-hidden live region announcing "Export started" when download begins. Also announce file type.
Leo (design): Region picker: proposal to show explicit placeholder "All regions" and a subtle down-chevron. When a single region selected show its short name (e.g., us-east) and a badge if it's restricted.
Rina (product): Also, product request: if a workspace has a region default we should show a subtle tag "Workspace default" next to the region, not in the main row. Keep row compact.
Ava (eng): We can add an attribute `data-region-default="true"` and render the tag. No API changes. Row height should remain 48px max.
Noah (a11y): Ensure the region badge has proper semantics if interactive. If it's non-interactive, render as `<span>` with `aria-hidden` and provide the info in the row's accessible description.
Leo (design): Microcopy final suggestion (single-line targets): Retention -> "Data retained for 30 days. Learn more." Region fallback -> "All regions" Badge labels -> "Redwood-managed key" / "Customer-managed key (BYOK)" Export CTA -> "Export filtered logs (CSV)" Tooltip -> "Export respects current filters and time range."
Dana (legal): Approve copies pending link target verification for "Learn more". Also confirm export wording in docs.
Ava (eng): I'll implement: DOM reorder to ensure region control > retention text > badges > actions. Add aria-describedby id on row for retention. Set Export default format to CSV. PR ETA: tomorrow morning.
Noah (a11y): I'll pair with QA on keyboard and SR flows. Quick checklist I'm tracking: focus order, live region for export status, tooltip accessibility, menu roles/labels.
Leo (design): Updated figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/compliance-compact (v2). Collapsed row screenshot attached there.
deploy-bot: Figma updated by Leo.
Rina (product): Thanks team. Please paste PR here when ready and we can do a quick ship-check before merge. :heart:
